notes.title: Excessive Training is available. And value of STAMIN is shown during the match.
notes.content:
Excessive Training is available. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38039463/79551dd4f618673ce5cbc3ce6d470846f641c2a0.jpg[/img]

Value of STAMIN is shown during the match.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38039463/0f18026713d479b875e55aba6ac9d18e6ac3a0bf.jpg[/img]

Also possibility of Purple color of newcomer is changed.
If the highest rank your stable has experienced is F, There's a 1% chance that Purple color appears at each ability.
E:2%, D:3%, C:4%, B:5%, A:6%, S3:7%, S2:8%, S1:9%, SS:15%
If the number of coaches is 1, There's a +1% chance that Purple color appears at each ability.
2:+5%, 3:+10%, 4:+11%, 5:+12%, more:+15%

notes.content:
I have removed the display of age. This is because internally, the Tsukedasi wrestler will be decided in the subsequent processing.

The prediction (purple) item was not fixed, so I fixed it.
